profile.name: Priyanshu Singh
profile.title: SAP BTP / CAPM Developer · SAP UI5 / Fiori Consultant
profile.intro: I build enterprise applications across SAP BTP—from CAP services and financial integrations to SAP Fiori and UI5 experiences, with 2+ years of experience at TruSpeQ Consulting.
profile.about: I work where business processes meet the systems that power them. At TruSpeQ Consulting, I’ve progressed from full-stack intern to technical consultant, building across data models, backend services and enterprise interfaces.
profile.aboutDetail: My work spans SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementations and support, including financial transactions, bulk uploads and e-Invoice compliance. I work across requirements, integration, authentication, deployment and production support.
resumeHighlights: SAP BTP / CAPM and SAPUI5/Fiori developer with 2+ years of experience at TruSpeQ Consulting Pvt. Ltd., an SAP Gold Partner.
Works across requirements analysis, application design, data modeling, service development, frontend/backend integration, authentication, deployment and production support.
Experience includes CAP service handlers, custom actions and functions, HANA persistence, AppRouter, XSUAA, MTA and Cloud Foundry deployment and Fiori Launchpad integration.
Has worked with SAP Fiori Freestyle and Fiori Elements, custom CDS views in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, bulk Excel-upload loaders, e-Invoice compliance and financial transaction processing.
Experience includes Cloud Foundry, SAP HANA Cloud, Destination Service, Job Scheduler and SAP Build Work Zone, troubleshooting and collaboration with functional and business teams.

projects.title: Master Data & Financial Transaction Ingestion Engine
projects.lead: Bringing external transactions into an enterprise landscape, with validation and traceability built into the journey.
projects.context: A microservices-based SAP BTP integration solution connecting Mobi transaction portals to SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud for master data and financial transactions.
projects.requirement: Ingest and validate CSV transaction files, consolidate payments into balanced journal entries, and support multiple company codes and currencies with traceable processing.
projects.implementation: Designed and developed CAP microservices and automated SFTP ingestion with file- and row-level validation, duplicate detection, idempotency and error reporting. Implemented atomic batch persistence, financial consolidation, audit logs, retries and alerts. Built OData V4 services, custom actions and two-way callbacks to update SAP document and business partner numbers and processing statuses.
projects.architecture: SAP CAP and Node.js, CDS models and SAP HANA Cloud, SFTP, OData V4, SAP CPI, S/4HANA Business Partner and Journal Entry APIs, XSUAA and Cloud Foundry. Supported CAP services and HANA HDI deployments across DEV, QA/UAT and production, including performance and security testing.
projects.outcomes: The résumé describes consolidation of thousands of daily payments into balanced multi-line accounting journal entries; no quantified improvement is stated.
resumeDetails: Designed SAP HANA Cloud data models for raw transactions, consolidated transactions, merchant master data and file-processing and audit logs.
Developed CSV ingestion with file-level and row-level validation, multi-layer checks, duplicate detection, idempotency and automated error reporting.
Implemented atomic all-or-nothing batch persistence and consolidation of thousands of daily payments into balanced multi-line accounting journal entries for multiple company codes and currencies.

Exposed OData V4 services and custom actions with server-side filtering for SAP CPI to trigger SAP S/4HANA Business Partner and Journal Entry APIs, with two-way callbacks to update document and BP numbers and processing status.
Worked with CAP services and HANA HDI containers across DEV, QA/UAT and production, including large-volume performance and security testing.

projects.title: Enterprise Financial & Operational Bulk Upload Framework
projects.lead: Turning complex bulk operations into structured, reusable upload workflows.
projects.context: A suite of Fiori/UI5 loader applications covering financial and operational processes, including assets, WBS, purchasing, service entry, goods receipt and payments.
projects.requirement: Provide reusable, validated Excel bulk-upload workflows for a broad range of SAP business processes, including a custom Purchase Order Bulk Loader.
projects.implementation: Developed reusable template-download, field-mapping and Excel-upload components with mandatory-field, data-type and business-rule validation, date/number conversion, multi-sheet uploads and dependent-record checks. Built payload transformation, valid/invalid filtering, atomic submission of valid entries, error handling, record tracking and audit-trail and Excel exports.
projects.architecture: SAP Fiori/UI5 and Fiori Elements in SAP Business Application Studio, JSON/OData models, OData and REST APIs, SAP BTP Cloud Foundry, and Fiori Launchpad tiles, catalogs and target mappings.
resumeDetails: Built a custom Purchase Order Bulk Loader on SAP BTP using Fiori Elements in SAP Business Application Studio.
Built template downloads, template-based field mapping, mandatory-field and data-type checks, date and number conversion, business rules, multi-sheet uploads and dependent-record validation.
Converted uploaded Excel data to SAP-compatible OData and REST payloads, filtered valid and invalid records, and supported atomic submission of valid entries with actionable error logs.
Used JSON/OData models, controllers, validation managers and export utilities for reusable services and components handling validation, transformations, responses, audit trails and Excel export.
Troubleshot payload mismatches, validation failures, HTTP and SAP backend errors, and deployed to Cloud Foundry with Fiori Launchpad tiles, catalogs and target mappings.

projects.title: Custom Bank Balance Report
projects.lead: A clearer view of bank balances, shaped around the filters finance teams need.
projects.context: A custom bank balance reporting application using a Fiori Elements List Report.
projects.requirement: Expose opening and closing balances with dynamic filtering by company code, G/L account and posting date.
projects.implementation: Developed a Fiori Elements List Report in SAP Business Application Studio, with custom CDS views, fields, UI annotations and opening/closing balance calculations. Exposed OData with dynamic filters and performed integration testing, data validation and performance optimization.
projects.architecture: SAP Fiori Elements, custom CDS views in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, OData, SAP BTP Cloud Foundry and Fiori Launchpad tiles, catalogs and target mappings.
resumeDetails: Developed a custom bank balance report using SAP Fiori Elements List Report in SAP Business Application Studio.
Designed custom CDS views in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud with fields, UI annotations and opening and closing balance logic.
Exposed OData with filters on company code, G/L account and posting date; performed integration testing, data validation and performance optimization.
Deployed to SAP BTP Cloud Foundry and configured Fiori Launchpad tiles, catalogs and target mappings.

projects.title: Employee Benefits & Management Applications
projects.lead: A connected portfolio of employee applications, built around reusable interface patterns.
projects.context: Eight SAPUI5/Fiori applications supporting employee benefits, allowances, loans and employee management for Dynamic Solutions in Brunei.
projects.requirement: Support related employee processes with maintainable interfaces and enterprise data integration.
projects.implementation: Developed and supported MVC-based SAPUI5 applications with XML views, fragments, reusable components, JSON/OData models, CRUD, routing and data binding. Configured Launchpad and Gateway/ICF services; handled enhancements, debugging, performance tuning and production support.
projects.architecture: SAPUI5, Fiori, XML, MVC, SAP Gateway OData, SAP ABAP Repository and SAP BTP Cloud Foundry.
resumeDetails: Developed and supported eight SAPUI5/Fiori applications using MVC, XML views and fragments, reusable components and SAP Fiori design principles.
Integrated SAP Gateway OData, JSON/OData models, CRUD, routing, navigation and dynamic data binding.
Configured Fiori Launchpad catalogs, groups, tiles and target mappings and activated ICF nodes and Gateway services.

Deployed across SAP ABAP Repository and SAP BTP Cloud Foundry and worked on enhancements, change requests, debugging, performance tuning and production support with functional consultants and business users.

projects.title: SAP Fiori My Inbox Extension
projects.lead: Extending a standard approval experience to connect the user action with backend workflow logic.
projects.context: An SAP ECC EHP8 upgrade and support project involving SAP Fiori My Inbox.
projects.requirement: Configure the standard inbox and support a custom approval action within the existing workflow landscape.
projects.implementation: Configured and activated standard My Inbox, OData Gateway services and ICF nodes; extended the UI5 application with a custom Approve action and backend workflow logic. Worked on SAP Task Gateway, Fiori Launchpad, PFCG role authorizations, end-to-end testing and troubleshooting.
projects.architecture: SAP ECC EHP8, SAP Fiori My Inbox, OData Gateway and ICF services, SAP Task Gateway, Fiori Launchpad and PFCG roles.
resumeDetails: Configured and activated the standard SAP Fiori My Inbox, OData Gateway services and ICF nodes in SAP ECC EHP8.
Extended the standard UI5 application with a custom Approve action and backend approval workflow logic.
Configured SAP Task Gateway integration, Fiori Launchpad catalogs, groups, tiles and target mappings, and PFCG role authorizations.
Performed end-to-end testing, troubleshooting and performance tuning for workflow item processing across system landscapes.
